texts.value: Enzyme with hydroxy-pyruvate reductase, glyoxylate reductase and D-glycerate dehydrogenase enzymatic activities. Reduces hydroxypyruvate to D-glycerate, glyoxylate to glycolate, oxidizes D-glycerate to hydroxypyruvate
Ubiquitous. Most abundantly expressed in the liver

disease.description: A disorder characterized by elevated urinary excretion of oxalate and L-glycerate, progressive tissue accumulation of insoluble calcium oxalate, nephrolithiasis, nephrocalcinosis, and end-stage renal disease.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
Belongs to the D-isomer specific 2-hydroxyacid dehydrogenase family
